item.pyrofuel.pyrocoke_mix.tooltip: Coke dust enriched with cinder flour. A base for solid and liquid pyrofuel.
item.pyrofuel.soaked_pyromass.tooltip: Creosote binds the embers of the Nether. Requires pressing.
item.pyrofuel.raw_pyrocoke_briquette.too: A pressed fuel charge. Cure in a basin over normal heat.
item.pyrofuel.pyrocoke_briquette.tooltip: Nether embers superheat a blaze burner for 160 seconds.
item.pyrofuel.stabilizing_additive.toolt: A mineral additive that keeps fiery particles suspended in fuel.
item.pyrofuel.raw_pyrogel_bucket.tooltip: Raw suspension. Stabilize with heat. Tank storage only; cannot be placed in the world.
item.pyrofuel.pyrogel_bucket.tooltip: CDG liquid burner fuel. Superheats above 80% valve opening. Unsuitable for engines.
